rightPlace.title: You're in the right place if…
items: Your last event was "fine," and you want more than fine.
You want people participating, not just watching.
You'd like the event to say something about your team or your mission.
You want one creative lead who handles it start to finish.

items.a: Pricing generally ranges from $2,000 to $5,000 depending on the complexity of the event. Event emcee services start at $100/hr, and can range depending on the scope of duties. A 50% deposit reserves your date and starts creative work; the remaining 50% is due after the event.
If your venue has a suitable setup, there's no equipment charge. If not, rental and delivery are quoted separately and added only with your approval before booking.
Yes. Travel outside the Birmingham area is discussed and approved in advance.
